_note: Sweep batch 01: tier-1 passages 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-27. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he sees the world economy going down like the Titanic, with people grabbing life vests and pulling each other underwater to stay afloat themselves.
mentions.quote: I saw the economy of the world going down like a Titanic
mentions.falsify_match: A global economic contraction severe enough to be described as a sinking, with visible scrambles for survival between institutions or states.
mentions.falsify_miss: World output and markets continue without a broad downturn.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a news segment saying crypto market-structure legislation aimed at 2026 could slip to 2027, that the SEC and CFTC remain supportive, and that Bitcoin trades at $78,441.
mentions.quote: for 2026 and could get delayed till 2027
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto market-structure law enacted in 2026 or 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such law by the end of 2027.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a map of licence-plate camera growth from 2024 to 2026, he says a surveillance state is being built, with databases that flag people automatically.
mentions.quote: I said a surve a surveillance state is
mentions.falsify_match: Continued measurable expansion of automated camera and database surveillance in US cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: Surveillance network growth stalls or reverses.

mentions.claim_text: With a blood moon falling this week he says September is nearly here and will be a time of great shakings in the days ahead, and tells viewers to watch it.
mentions.quote: it will be a time of uh great shakings in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: September 2026 brings events widely described as major shakings, whether seismic, financial or political.
mentions.falsify_miss: September 2026 passes as an unremarkable month.

mentions.claim_text: He says distractions like January 6th will recur, that cities will be shaken all at one time, and that this covers economic trouble in Canada and America; he saw whiskey barrels rolling down and breaking on the land.
mentions.quote: he showed me again cities again that would happen all at one time
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous unrest or attacks across multiple US cities coinciding with a Canadian economic crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: No multi-city simultaneous event occurs.

mentions.claim_text: Commenting on fuel news, he notes queues for gas affecting rich and poor alike and says the Lord had warned about it, with the situation improving by early August.
mentions.quote: the situation improved by early August
mentions.falsify_match: Documented fuel queues and rationing in the referenced country.
mentions.falsify_miss: No fuel queueing episode is on record.

mentions.claim_text: He reads news that Ukraine is being denied Starlink support for long-range strikes on Russia, and that Russia and North Korea are finishing their first road bridge in September.
mentions.quote: So they're finishing it in September
mentions.falsify_match: The Russia-North Korea road bridge is reported complete in September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Completion slips past September 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He dates an earlier word to 21 July 2025, thirteen months prior, and ties it to news of a reported ten million dollar bounty involving Barron Trump entering a new building.
mentions.quote: July the 21st of 2025 is when we saw it
mentions.falsify_match: A threat or bounty against a member of the president's family is reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such report exists.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a vision from about July in which permission is granted to dig deep and uncover Noah's ark, with petrified boards visibly built together and shaped rock.
mentions.quote: permission to dig uh deep down and find uh stuff about Noah's ark
mentions.falsify_match: An excavation permit is issued and worked timber is recovered at a site publicly identified with Noah's ark.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such permit or find is reported.

mentions.claim_text: Reading that the US has issued a Mexico travel warning over an unspecified threat, he links it to his earlier word of cartel turf wars, major uprisings, and Claudia Sheinbaum losing control and being forced out of government.
mentions.quote: I saw Claudia losing control and she'll be drugged out of her government
mentions.falsify_match: Cartel turf wars escalate into uprisings and Mexico's president loses office or effective control.
mentions.falsify_miss: Sheinbaum serves without losing control.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces the prayer session and points viewers back to his 2027 video, saying what it describes is four different cycles rather than a single one.
mentions.quote: It's four different cycles, not f
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a pointer to his own earlier video and a framing note.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he declares that the Clarity Act bill is passed and will go into full force by 15 September, calling it a September to remember and a month of breakthrough.
mentions.quote: It will go full force by the 15th of September
mentions.falsify_match: The Clarity Act is passed and in force on or before 15 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: 15 September 2026 passes with the bill unpassed or not in force.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers to watch the UN in September, to watch Canada, and says something is brewing about Europe; he repeatedly sees a clown fish hiding in the coral as the image for it.
mentions.quote: watch even in the UN in the days ahead in September
mentions.falsify_match: A significant UN development in September 2026 involving Canada or Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: The UN September session passes without notable Canada or Europe developments.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he says they are looking for a new January 6th and sees January 6th pop up again as a distraction.
mentions.quote: for new January 6. I see January 6th pop
mentions.falsify_match: A January 6th style incident or renewed January 6th news cycle used to dominate coverage.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such incident or news cycle appears.

mentions.claim_text: He says distractions like a January 6th will keep coming in the news to draw attention away from what is really happening, and names the alien files as one of them.
mentions.quote: Distractions will come in the news
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of high-profile news stories, including UAP or alien file releases, coincides with major economic or political action elsewhere.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such pattern of coverage occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says things are about to accelerate at such a pace that a year from now viewers will look back astonished, and that he can see into the next seven years.
mentions.quote: you'll look back even next year at this time
mentions.time_phrase: next year at this time, next seven years
mentions.falsify_match: The year to August 2027 is widely regarded as exceptionally eventful.
mentions.falsify_miss: The year passes as ordinary.

mentions.claim_text: He urges listeners to feel the urgency and tell family and neighbours that Jesus Christ is coming, without arguing scripture at them.
mentions.quote: an urgency to tell your loved ones that Jesus Christ is coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation to evangelise, not a prediction.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told a shaking was coming to the church, and that the first wave would pull back before a second wave arrived later at double the size of the first.
mentions.quote: another wave that's greater will come at a later time
mentions.falsify_match: A second crisis at roughly twice the severity of the 2020 episode.
mentions.falsify_miss: No second, larger wave arrives.

mentions.claim_text: He says a seven-year cycle has run since the 2019-2020 warning, that the sequence was COVID then war, and that we have now entered the eye of the storm.
mentions.quote: you have now entered into the eye of the storm
mentions.falsify_match: A visible lull through late 2026 into 2027 followed by renewed crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: Conditions worsen continuously with no lull, or improve durably.

mentions.claim_text: He says the coming cycle will be much greater than the 2019-2020 one, and that water shortages and drought will get severe enough to force people out of their towns and cities.
mentions.quote: people would have to move out of towns
mentions.falsify_match: Water scarcity drives documented depopulation of US towns or cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No water-driven relocation at that scale occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He sees JD Vance reaching across the aisle and shaking hands with Democrats, a divided red line turning blue then purple, and Rubio standing in the background, all set around 2028 amid much darkness.
mentions.quote: I saw what was red become blue and purple in a line that was divided
mentions.falsify_match: Vance forms a visible bipartisan alliance with Democrats around 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Vance stays on partisan lines through 2028.

mentions.claim_text: He sees businesses relocating to Texas and Oklahoma, tech and oil firms renting space in the OU tower, an oil boom, and Oklahoma schools rising in standing.
mentions.quote: But I heard oil boom and I saw uh Oklahoma schools becoming
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable corporate migration to Texas and Oklahoma alongside an oil production boom.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such relocation wave or boom materialises.

mentions.claim_text: As Iran draws back he sees Iraq and Babylon rise and the prince of Persia retreat, and hears that spots of revival will break out over Egypt, Jordan, Iran and Iraq.
mentions.quote: spots of revival will now break forth over the Middle East
mentions.falsify_match: Reported Christian revival movements across Egypt, Jordan, Iran and Iraq.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable revival activity in those countries.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the crypto bill is scheduled for 15 September at 2 p.m. and says a shifting and shaking will take place, a metamorphosis, with birthing pains doubling.
mentions.quote: a metamorphosis of things and the birthing pains will double
mentions.falsify_match: The scheduled 15 September 2026 vote takes place and passes.
mentions.falsify_miss: The vote is cancelled, postponed, or fails.

mentions.claim_text: He lines the digital bill vote on 15 September up against Rosh Hashanah on the 11th to 13th, says to watch the fall feast as the time of acceleration, and sees further economic acceleration around January and February.
mentions.quote: watch the fall feast of Rashashana for this will be the time of acceleration
mentions.time_phrase: Rosh Hashanah to 15 September, then January and February
mentions.falsify_match: A marked acceleration in economic and crypto events from mid-September 2026 into early 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: The period is quiet.

mentions.claim_text: He replays a vision dated 26 March in which Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America hold a rope tied to a rocket and pull it down, with Brad Garlinghouse standing at the edge.
mentions.quote: Saw the three big banks, Chase, Wells Fargo, and Bank of America holding a rope
mentions.falsify_match: Major US banks are shown to have suppressed a crypto asset that then rises sharply once they stop.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such suppression or subsequent rise is evident.

mentions.claim_text: In the same vision Garlinghouse smiles and says all he needs is clarity and the rest works itself out, standing at a volatile waterbrook, knowing the banks' season on the rope is nearly done.
mentions.quote: All we need is clarity and the rest will work out itself
mentions.falsify_match: Regulatory clarity arrives and the suppression he describes visibly ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: No clarity arrives, or it arrives with no market effect.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an 18 August clip of Brad Garlinghouse saying a federal judge ruled XRP is not itself a security and that Ripple has leaned in aggressively to support the Clarity Act.
mentions.quote: We need clarity for the whole industry
mentions.falsify_match: The quoted clip exists and says what he reports.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip is misquoted or does not exist.

mentions.claim_text: He reports that SpaceX Starlink has now partnered with 48 airlines covering over 7,000 aircraft, and says Starlink is really taking off.
mentions.quote: Starlink has now partnered with 48 airlines covering over 7,000 airplanes
mentions.falsify_match: Starlink aviation partnerships at or above the reported scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: The partnership count is materially lower.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch Russia and China in the days ahead and that they will be seen picking fights with South Korea, then turns to a New York terror plot arrest.
mentions.quote: you'll see them picking fights with of South Korea in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: Russian or Chinese provocations against South Korea escalate visibly.
mentions.falsify_miss: Relations with South Korea stay routine.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a poll where Rubio outperforms Vance in 2028 matchups, he says he believes the Lord wants Rubio, while seeing Vance trying to get a running start between the two.
mentions.quote: This is what I believe the Lord wants
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio emerges as the 2028 Republican standard bearer, with Vance on the ticket or contesting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither leads the 2028 ticket.

mentions.claim_text: Aside about the new White House helicopter pad sparing officials the walk across the lawn, with a story about Obama and an umbrella.
mentions.quote: So, that helicopter pad's neat, though
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: banter about a construction project, no prediction made.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a vision from about a year earlier of Trump moving into the fall, then reaching January and signing a parchment scroll with a golden quill pen.
mentions.quote: he had a quill pen, golden w
mentions.falsify_match: A ceremonial signing of a founding-document style instrument by Trump around January 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such signing occurs.

mentions.claim_text: In the same sequence he sees digital platforms for money, oil derricks pumping everywhere with great oil wealth, drill baby drill repeated, and a year of fixing running into May with drones involved.
mentions.quote: I saw great oil wealth. I'm talking wells opened up everywhere
mentions.falsify_match: A large US drilling expansion alongside a digital money platform push by May 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs in that window.

mentions.claim_text: He says something is coming with interest rates, and sees a changed economy across May, June and July heading into the 2026 Senate, House and governor elections as officials pump the economy to make it look amazing.
mentions.quote: trying to pump the economy to make it look amazing
mentions.time_phrase: May, June, July into the 2026 elections
mentions.falsify_match: Rate cuts and stimulus visibly timed to the midterm cycle.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such pre-election economic push.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a gold layer on the soil that people scoop into their pockets but which is too thin to build a foundation on, and Trump parading a pig in makeup that stays a pig, as the economy is boosted.
mentions.quote: Trump was parading a pig, a pig with makeup
mentions.falsify_match: A short-lived prosperity window that is later judged cosmetic.
mentions.falsify_miss: The gains prove durable and structurally sound.

mentions.claim_text: He states this is not financial advice but a vision and a warning, and tells viewers who expect to be raptured out beforehand that they need not follow the channel.
mentions.quote: it's not financial advice. This is just a vision
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a disclaimer, not a prediction.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing battleships surrounding Venezuela in a vision dated 3 January, with Russia present, and being told it is about more than drug trafficking.
mentions.quote: I saw battleships all around Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: A US naval concentration around Venezuela driven by aims beyond counter-narcotics.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such deployment, or a purely counter-narcotics one.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a week of quakes including a 6.7 plus 7.7 and 7.4 events around the ring of fire and calls them major shakings to awaken the world.
mentions.quote: we have all kinds of major uh shakings to awaken all around the world
mentions.falsify_match: A continuing elevated rate of large ring-of-fire earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Seismic rates return to baseline.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he calls in a caravan of camels loaded with goods and overflow, and declares that seeds sown sacrificially in the past are coming to harvest at last.
mentions.quote: the seeds from the past are coming to harvest at last
mentions.falsify_match: A documented transfer of wealth to the audience he prays for.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such transfer occurs.
